text: Alice was sitting. <break time="0.8s" /> By her sister. <break time="0.8s" /> On a river bank. <break time="0.8s" /> And she was very bored. <break time="0.8s" /> Once or twice. <break time="0.8s" /> She looked into the book. <break time="0.8s" /> That her sister was reading. <break time="0.8s" /> But it had no pictures. <break time="0.8s" /> Or conversations in it. <break time="0.8s" /> And what is the use of a book. <break time="0.8s" /> Thought Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> Without pictures or conversations. <break time="0.8s" /> The hot day made her. <break time="0.8s" /> Feel sleepy and a little stupid. <break time="0.8s" /> She was wondering. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether she should get up. <break time="0.8s" /> And make a daisy chain. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly a White Rabbit. <break time="0.8s" /> With pink eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Ran close by her. <break time="0.8s" /> The Rabbit said to itself. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh dear, Oh dear. <break time="0.8s" /> I shall be late. <break time="0.8s" /> But then the Rabbit took a watch. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of its waistcoat pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> And hurried on. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice jumped up. <break time="0.8s" /> Because she had never seen. <break time="0.8s" /> A rabbit with a pocket or a watch. <break time="0.8s" /> She ran after it. <break time="0.8s" /> And saw it pop down. <break time="0.8s" /> A large rabbit hole under the hedge. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice went down after it. <break time="0.8s" /> Without thinking. <break time="0.8s" /> How she would get out.
